data.title: Build Your Own Molecule
data.description: Students use an empty board and special pieces to construct custom molecules that meet specific chemical challenges.

challenges.instruction: Make a molecule with a double bond.
challenges.hint: Count the bonds each atom makes. In a molecule, every atom uses all of its bonds.
challenges.narration: Every atom uses all of its bonds: that is a real molecule!

challenges.instruction: Make a molecule with a double bond and exactly 2 carbon atoms.
challenges.hint: Count the bonds each atom makes. In a molecule, every atom uses all of its bonds.
challenges.narration: Every atom uses all of its bonds: that is a real molecule!

challenges.instruction: Make a molecule with a double bond and a nitrogen atom.
challenges.hint: Count the bonds each atom makes. In a molecule, every atom uses all of its bonds.
challenges.narration: Every atom uses all of its bonds: that is a real molecule!

challenges.instruction: Make a molecule with two double bonds.
challenges.hint: Count the bonds each atom makes. In a molecule, every atom uses all of its bonds.
challenges.narration: Every atom uses all of its bonds: that is a real molecule!
